title: Frequently asked questions
intro: Answers to common questions about choosing, ordering and placing a memorial. If you don't see your question here, we're happy to help.

questions.question: What's the difference between flat, bevel and slant markers?
questions.answer: A flat marker sits level with the ground. A bevel marker is slightly raised with a gently sloped face, and a slant marker has a steeper angled face that's easier to read while standing. Some cemeteries only allow certain types, so we'll check before you decide.

questions.question: What granite colors are available?
questions.answer: Every design is available in 21 granite colors: 8 stock colors and 13 special-order colors. Special-order colors may require a longer lead time or additional cost. Select View colors on any design in our gallery to see them all.

questions.question: Can you add a photo, emblem or custom artwork?
questions.answer: Photos, etchings, emblems and other artwork are available as customizations on some monuments. Contact our team to talk about your specific needs.

questions.question: Do you create fully custom designs?
questions.answer: Yes. From traditional monuments and markers to fully customized designs, we'll help bring your vision to life. Every design in our gallery can also be adapted in size, color and lettering.

questions.question: Can I plan a memorial ahead of time?
questions.answer: Yes. Many people choose and design a memorial in advance, so their loved ones won't have to make these decisions later. We'll walk you through the options and help you plan at your own pace.

questions.question: Can names or dates be added later, such as for a companion memorial?
questions.answer: Yes. When the time comes, contact us and we'll coordinate adding the new details to your memorial. Customizations are priced individually, so later additions are quoted separately from the original memorial.

questions.question: How long does it take to get a headstone?
questions.answer: Most memorials take a minimum of 6 weeks from order to installation. Timing depends on the design, the granite color and the cemetery's schedule, and we'll give you an estimated timeline when you place your order.

questions.question: Will I see a proof before it's made?
questions.answer: Yes. You'll review and approve a design proof showing the layout, lettering and any artwork before anything is made.

questions.question: Does my cemetery have rules about memorial size or type?
questions.answer: Many cemeteries have rules about the size, type and placement of memorials. Tell us which cemetery you're working with and we'll help you find a design that meets its requirements.

questions.question: Do you handle installation?
questions.answer: Yes. We install your memorial, and the foundation is included. We coordinate with the cemetery, so you don't have to manage the details yourself.

questions.question: What areas do you serve?
questions.answer: We serve families throughout Central Kentucky, including Frankfort, Lexington, Harrodsburg, Shelbyville, Bardstown, Taylorsville, Lebanon, Hodgenville, Lawrenceburg, Richmond, Berea, Cynthiana, New Castle, Eminence and the surrounding counties. We can also travel to cemeteries farther away on request.

questions.question: How much does a memorial cost?
questions.answer: There are too many variables to list a single price: the design, size, granite color, lettering and artwork all play a part. Request information or give us a call and we'll prepare a quote with no cost or obligation.

questions.question: Do you offer payment plans?
questions.answer: Payment options depend on the memorial and your situation. We'll talk them through with you when we prepare your quote.
